title: Critical Apparatus Encoding & TEI Apparatus Structures
query: How do digital scholarly editions model critical apparatus structures and textual variation across manuscript traditions, and how do automated tools and large language models assist in apparatus encoding and verification?

results.title: Computational Reuse of Printed Critical Apparatuses
